text.en: USGS — Understanding plate motions. F13; chapter 02. Transform boundaries: mainly horizontal motion without systematic creation or consumption of crust.
text.zh: USGS《理解板块运动》。F13；第 02 章。转换边界主要水平运动，不会持续产生或消耗地壳。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Public indexed page text read; direct page returned 403. Used only for the indexed transform statement, independently corroborated by S45. F11/F12 use S7 full text.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读公开索引正文；直接页面返回 403。只采用索引中转换运动的说法，由 S45 独立支持；F11/F12 采用 S7 全文。

text.en: BGS — What causes earthquakes?. F01–F03,F25; chapters 00–02/05. Solid mantle that deforms over long times, lithosphere, typical relative motion of a few centimetres per year, and release of stored elastic strain energy.
text.zh: 英国地质调查局《地震的成因》。F01–F03、F25；第 00–02、05 章。固态地幔的长期变形、岩石圈、每年几厘米的典型相对运动与储存弹性应变能的释放。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: opening, The mantle and Plate tectonics. No additional layer dimensions or plate totals adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：开头、The mantle、Plate tectonics。不采用额外分层尺寸或板块总数。

text.en: NOAA — JetStream Max: Plate Tectonics and Earthquakes. F01,F04,F10–F13; chapters 01–02. Lithosphere, plates with continental and oceanic crust, separating/converging/transform motions, subduction and continental collision.
text.zh: NOAA《板块构造与地震》。F01、F04、F10–F13；第 01–02 章。岩石圈、同时带大陆与海洋地壳的板块、分离／汇聚／转换、俯冲与大陆碰撞。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: Earth layers and Plate Boundaries. Basic motions only, not an exhaustive global boundary classification.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：地球分层与 Plate Boundaries。只讲基本运动，不作为完整全球边界分类。

text.en: USGS — Introduction to Subduction Zones: Amazing Events in Subduction Zones. F14; chapter 02 and slab/melt details. Water transported to depth in sediment and subducting plate rocks enables magma formation; the teaching melt region lies above the descending slab.
text.zh: USGS《俯冲带中的地质过程》。F14；第 02 章与板片／熔融区详情。沉积物与俯冲岩石将水带到深处，有助岩浆形成；教学熔融区位于下降板片上方。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Preparation spec records full text read. Construction recheck: direct page showed a robot-verification screen; no verification attempted. Publicly indexed page body retrieved, including Erupting Volcanoes water-and-melting paragraph. No page figures redistributed.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。准备规格记录已读全文。施工重查时直接页面要求机器人验证，未尝试通过；取得公开索引正文，包括 Erupting Volcanoes 中水与熔融段。不再发行网页图。

text.en: NPS — Volcanic Eruptions. F19–F22,FIE06; chapters 03–04. Magma/lava, local melt-and-crystal storage, no core supply, conduit/vent, falling pressure, gas exsolution, viscosity and varied eruptive activity.
text.zh: 美国国家公园管理局《火山喷发》。F19–F22、FIE06；第 03–04 章。岩浆／熔岩、局部熔体与晶体储存、供浆不来自地核、通道／喷发口、降压析气、黏度与多样喷发活动。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: Introduction, Generation and Rise of Magma, Composition & Viscosity, Gas content & exsolution and Rate of Eruption. No eruption dates, flow speeds or classification counts adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：Introduction、Generation and Rise of Magma、Composition & Viscosity、Gas content & exsolution、Rate of Eruption。不采用喷发年代、流速或形态分类数量。

text.en: Meteorological Service Singapore — Earthquakes and Volcanoes. F25–F26,F29,F43; chapters 05/07. Fault locking and slip, focus and epicentre, limits of exact prediction, Singapore setting away from major active boundaries.
text.zh: 新加坡气象署《地震与火山》。F25–F26、F29、F43；第 05、07 章。断层锁定与滑动、震源／震中、精确预测限制、新加坡远离主要活动边界的区位。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: Earthquakes, Plate Tectonics and The Unpredictability of Earthquakes. Do not reuse its crust-only simplification of a plate, historical figures or regional plate-naming comparisons.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：Earthquakes、Plate Tectonics、The Unpredictability of Earthquakes。不沿用板块只包含地壳的简化，不采用历史数字或地区板块命名比较。

text.en: NOAA — Tsunamis. F30; chapter 06. Long-wave series from sudden large water displacement; earthquakes, landslides and volcanic activity as causes; unrelated to tides.
text.zh: NOAA《海啸》。F30；第 06 章。大量水体突然位移产生长波列；地震、滑坡与火山活动等成因；与潮汐无关。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full definition read. Historical losses, meteorites and weather mechanisms lie outside this topic.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读完整定义。历史损失、陨石与天气机制不在本题范围。

text.en: NOAA — Tsunami Generation: Earthquakes. F31; chapter 06 and seafloor source details. Vertical seafloor change displaces the overlying water in the illustrated earthquake mechanism.
text.zh: NOAA《地震产生海啸》。F31；第 06 章与海床源详情。示例地震机制中，海床垂直变化移开上方海水。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: ocean-floor displacement sequence. Not every earthquake generates a tsunami. The on/off switch removes only the source drawn in this model.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文中海床位移序列。不是每次地震都产生海啸；开关只移除本模型所画的源。

text.en: NOAA — Tsunami Propagation. F32–F33,SIM-T; chapter 06. Whole-depth motion, wavelength, shallow-water slowing and possible height increase; speed c≈√(gh), with g≈9.8 m/s².
text.zh: NOAA《海啸传播》。F32–F33、SIM-T；第 06 章。全水深运动、波长、浅水减速与可能增高；速度近似 c≈√(gh)，g≈9.8 米每平方秒。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read, especially Fast Facts and shallow-water paragraphs. Model depths and resulting speeds belong to S63; formula does not calculate model flooding, wave height or real arrival time.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文，重点为 Fast Facts 与浅水段。模型水深和结果属于 S63；公式不计算模型淹没、波高或真实到岸时间。

text.en: Building and Construction Authority — Precautions to take during earth tremors. F44,F60; chapter 07. BCA states that Singapore buildings are designed to withstand distant tremors; felt Sumatra earthquakes; indoor advice to take cover under a table and not use lifts.
text.zh: 新加坡建设局《远震注意事项》。F44、F60；第 07 章。BCA 说明新加坡建筑按抵御远震震动设计，可感到苏门答腊远震；室内建议包括到桌下躲避、不用电梯。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Live full page rechecked 2026-10-27; footer updated 2026-10-23. Opening and What to do during earth tremors. Short original paraphrase only, with direct link to complete guidance. Not a guarantee about every structure in every earthquake.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。2026-10-27 重查在线全文；页脚更新为 2026-10-23。定位开头与 What to do during earth tremors。只作简短原创转述并链接完整指南，不保证每栋楼在任何地震中都安全。

text.en: BGS — How do earthquakes affect people?. F45,FIE05; chapter 07. Ground conditions, vibration/resonance, correctly tied walls and floors, and suitable structural support influence response.
text.zh: 英国地质调查局《地震的影响》。F45、FIE05；第 07 章。地面条件、振动／共振、墙与楼板的正确连接及合适支撑影响结构响应。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: Ground conditions, Building design and construction, Materials and Resonant frequency. No historical casualties, HDB configuration, building-code compliance or continuous-load-path claim adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：Ground conditions、Building design and construction、Materials、Resonant frequency。不采用历史伤亡、组屋配置、规范合规或连续传力路径主张。

text.en: Hong Kong Observatory — 如何解读地震参数？. F27; chapter 05 More. Event magnitude differs from the intensity of effects at a particular place; Chinese terms for focus, epicentre and P/S waves.
text.zh: 香港天文台《如何解读地震参数》。F27；第 05 章细看。事件震级与某地影响烈度不同；震源、震中、P／S 波中文用语。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full May 2023 article read. No event magnitudes, magnitude-energy ratios or additional numerical examples adopted. Not labelled Singapore-standard terminology.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读 2023 年 5 月文章全文。不采用事件震级、震级能量倍数或其他数值例题；不称新加坡标准译名。

text.en: CEDD — 板块运动——强大的力量. F13–F14 and Chinese terminology; chapters 01–04. Readable Chinese explanation of plate motions and local magma material including crystals and gas.
text.zh: 香港土木工程拓展署《板块运动——强大的力量》。F13–F14 与中文术语；第 01–04 章。可读中文板块运动说明，以及包括晶体与气体的局部岩浆材料。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full page read: Plate boundary types and Magma activity. Transform claim supported directly; water-assisted melting uses S9 indexed text because the extracted S45 text does not independently expose that statement. Fixed lithosphere depths and simplified mantle drivers are not adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读全文：板块边缘类型与岩浆活动。直接支持转换运动；水辅助熔融由 S9 索引正文支持，因为 S45 提取正文未独立呈现该句。不采用固定岩石圈深度或简化地幔驱动力。

text.en: NOAA — Tsunami Inundation. F61; chapter 06 More. A tsunami need not arrive trough first, and its first wave need not be largest.
text.zh: NOAA《海啸到岸》。F61；第 06 章细看。海啸不一定先到波谷，首波也不一定最大。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full relevant paragraphs read. Run-up definition, historical events, arrival times and inundation dimensions omitted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读完整相关段落。不采用爬高定义、历史事件、到时或淹没尺寸。

text.en: NASA/NSSDCA — Earth Fact Sheet. FIE01; chapters 00–01 and globe geometry. Volumetric mean radius 6,371 km and core outer radius 3,485 km.
text.zh: NASA／NSSDCA《地球资料表》。FIE01；第 00–01 章与球体几何。体积平均半径 6371 千米，地核外界半径 3485 千米。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Bulk parameters read. The spherical teaching geometry combines this source with S59, not a single seismic reference model. Mean gravity 9.820 is not used in the S15-based long-wave calculation.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读 Bulk parameters。教学球体与 S59 数值拼合，并非同一地震参考模型；不将平均重力 9.820 混入基于 S15 的长波计算。

text.en: NASA Science — Facts About Earth. FIE02–FIE03; chapters 00–01. Solid-metal inner core, radius about 1,221 km; liquid-metal outer core; land-crust average about 30 km and oceanic example about 5 km.
text.zh: NASA Science《地球概况》。FIE02–FIE03；第 00–01 章。固态金属内核半径约 1221 千米；液态金属外核；陆壳平均约 30 千米与海壳示例约 5 千米。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Structure section read. Its molten-mantle simplification is expressly not adopted; mantle state follows S6. Uniform 30 km crust is a model choice (S63), not measured global crust. Rounded layer thicknesses are not summed.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读 Structure。明确不采用其熔融地幔简化，地幔物态按 S6。均匀 30 千米地壳是模型选择（S63），不是全球实测；不将页面取整层厚相加。

text.en: BGS — How are earthquakes detected, located and measured?. FIE04; chapter 05. P motion parallel and S motion perpendicular to propagation, P faster in a solid, S unable to travel directly through liquid outer core; surface waves also contribute to ground movement.
text.zh: 英国地质调查局《地震的探测、定位与测量》。FIE04；第 05 章。P 振动平行、S 振动垂直传播方向，固体中 P 较快，S 不能直接穿液态外核；地面运动也包含表面波。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Seismic waves and property table read. Published typical km/s speeds are not copied into the teaching model; model constants and snapshots use S63.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读 Seismic waves 与属性表。不把公开典型千米每秒波速抄成模型参数；模型常数与快照按 S63。

text.en: Atlas Earth-process teaching design study, docs/48-inside-the-earth-content-spec.md §§0–3.5. Independent scales: 91 logical parts, 27 poses, background plus seven chapters and 36 beats. Approximate Earth sphere: R=6371 km; inner-core radius 1221 km; outer-core outer radius 3485 km; uniform 30 km land-crust example; mantle outer radius 6341 km. Derived shell thicknesses: outer core 2264 km, mantle 2856 km, crust 30 km; radii divided by 6371 without prior rounding. The local plate sample enlarges layers; boundary displacement/time, ash grains, fault deformation and structure lean are illustrative. Generic structure: four drawn floors; ground/foundation offset ±0.02 scene units and connected superstructure lean ±1 degree, not an HDB design or structural solution. Wave snapshots (SIM-W): x=0,0.5,…,8 in two 17-marker rows; A=0.08 scene units, f=1/model second, cP=4 and cS=2 diagram units/model second. k=0…8, t=0.25k, τ=t−x/c; u=0 outside 0≤τ≤1/f, otherwise u=A sin(2πfτ). P offset=(u,0,0), S offset=(0,u,0); inspected wave front=c*t. Scene x scale 0.4 is layout only; du is not metre. Both rows share each instant and are separate wave-type comparisons; their offsets are not added. Water symbols (SIM-S): j=−8…8, A=0.12, q=0…8, d=0.5(q−1), K(v)=max(0,1−|v|); for source on and q≥1, η(j)=A/2 [K(j−d)+K(j+d)−K(j−1−d)−K(j+1+d)], glyph offset=(0,η,0). Bed centre rises 0.06, neighbours fall 0.03 scene units and retain the offset. At q0 or source off all offsets are zero; each snapshot Ση=0 (symbol balance only). q is a diagram step, not seconds; changing depth leaves these snapshots unchanged. The shore shape is separate and qualitative. Long-wave speeds (SIM-T): c=√(9.8h) m/s and c×3.6 km/h. At design depths h=100/1000/4000 m, unrounded c=31.304951684997/98.994949366117/197.989898732233 and km/h=112.697826065989/356.381817718020/712.763635436040. Display one decimal: 31.3/99.0/198.0 m/s and 112.7/356.4/712.8 km/h; prose rounds to about 113/356/713 km/h. Source off still returns theoretical speed if a wave is present. Six defaults: wave-kind=p, wave-step=0, water-depth=4000, sea-step=0, sea-uplift=true, flow-mode=none. Tables have 18 wave, 18 displacement and 3 depth rows; output shapes bind to precomputed zero-duration poses. Flows: magma-path count120/speed0.15 and lava-path count80/speed0.08 are visibility choices, not rates of magma transport.
text.zh: Atlas 地球过程教学设计研究，依据 docs/48-inside-the-earth-content-spec.md 第 0–3.5 节。各小样独立尺度：91 个逻辑零件、27 个姿态、背景加七章共 36 拍。近似地球：半径 6371 千米，内核半径 1221 千米，外核外界半径 3485 千米；采用均匀 30 千米陆壳示例，地幔外半径 6341 千米。相减得到设计厚度：外核 2264、地幔 2856、地壳 30 千米；比例由原数除 6371，不先舍入。岩石圈小样放大层厚，边界位移与时间、灰粒、断层变形及建筑倾斜均为示意。通用结构绘四层楼板；地面／基础偏移 ±0.02 场景单位，上部相连结构倾斜 ±1 度；并非组屋设计或结构求解。SIM-W 波快照：两排各 17 个标记，逻辑 x=0、0.5…8；A=0.08 场景单位、f=每模型秒 1 周、cP=4、cS=2 图解单位每模型秒。k=0…8，t=0.25k，τ=t−x/c；τ 不在 [0,1/f] 内时 u=0，否则 u=A sin(2πfτ)。P 偏移 (u,0,0)，S 偏移 (0,u,0)，观察的波前=c*t。场景 x 缩放 0.4 只为排版，du 不是米。两排采用相同模型时刻，是不同波型的比较，不将偏移叠加。SIM-S 水位符号：j=−8…8，A=0.12，q=0…8，d=0.5(q−1)，K(v)=max(0,1−|v|)；源开且 q≥1 时 η(j)=A/2 [K(j−d)+K(j+d)−K(j−1−d)−K(j+1+d)]，符号偏移 (0,η,0)。中央海床升 0.06，两邻区各降 0.03 场景单位并保留错距；q0 或源关时全部偏移为零。每步 Ση=0 只代表符号正负平衡；q 是图解步骤而非秒，水深不改变快照；近岸形状另作定性示意。SIM-T 长波速度：c=√(9.8h) 米每秒，乘 3.6 换算千米每小时。设计水深 h=100／1000／4000 米，未舍入速度分别为 31.304951684997／98.994949366117／197.989898732233 米每秒，或每小时 112.697826065989／356.381817718020／712.763635436040 千米。显示一位小数：31.3／99.0／198.0 与 112.7／356.4／712.8；正文约为每小时 113／356／713 千米。源关时仍给出存在长波时的理论速度。六默认控件：wave-kind=p、wave-step=0、water-depth=4000、sea-step=0、sea-uplift=true、flow-mode=none。波表 18 行、位移表 18 行、水深表 3 行；形状输出绑定离线生成的零时长姿态。岩浆流 count120／speed0.15、熔岩流 count80／speed0.08 只是可读性设计，不是物质真实输送速率。

note.en: Not measured. Finite snapshots are generated offline from the stated formulas, with scientific basis S15/S60 and Earth dimensions S58/S59; mantle state follows S6. The model does not calculate real arrival times, inundation, wave height, water velocity/pressure/energy, building safety or eruptions. No prediction or diagnosis. Internal double precision is retained; displayed values are rounded only afterwards. All geometry, cameras and motion exaggerations are design choices.
note.zh: 非实测；按所述公式离线生成有限快照，科学依据为 S15／S60，地球尺寸依据 S58／S59，地幔物态依据 S6。不计算真实到时、淹没、波高、水流速度／压力／能量、建筑安全或喷发；不作预测或诊断。内部保留双精度，最后才对显示值舍入。几何、镜头与运动放大均为设计选择。

text.en: USGS — What is a hotspot and how do you know it's there?. F18; chapter 02 More. Volcanic activity can occur inside plates at hotspots.
text.zh: USGS《热点是什么》。F18；第 02 章细看。板块内部也可出现热点火山活动。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Full opening read. No claim that hotspots are absolutely fixed forever; no island ages or named examples added to the lesson.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读完整开头。不称热点永久绝对不动；不增加岛龄或命名实例。

text.en: NPS — Volcanic Ash, Tephra Fall, and Fallout Deposits. F24; chapter 04. Ash contains rock, mineral and glass fragments, not combustion ash; adopted diameter definition below 2 mm.
text.zh: 美国国家公园管理局《火山灰及降落堆积》。F24；第 04 章。火山灰含岩石、矿物和玻璃碎屑，不是燃烧灰；采用直径小于 2 毫米的定义。

note.en: Rechecked 2026-10-27. Volcanic Ash section read. Replaces inaccessible parent S52. Other sources sometimes use 2 mm or smaller; this topic attributes its chosen definition to NPS and does not quiz the boundary.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 复核。已读 Volcanic Ash，替代父来源中无法访问的 S52。其他来源有时写 2 毫米或更小；本题明确按 NPS 的所选定义，不考界值。
